title: AI isn't just for coders
hook: AI and using AI should not just be for developers, it should be for everyone.
summary: How I use Claude AI for everyday tasks (no coding needed) 👇
body: How I use Claude AI for everyday tasks (no coding needed) 👇
AI shouldn't only be for developers. Here are 3 ways I use it for normal life admin:

1. Google Drive clean-up. Claude's Google Drive connector sorted my mess into folders and flagged files to review before deleting.
2. Notion dashboard. Claude connects to Notion, so I just talk to it and it tidies my content and planning pages.
3. Email triage. Claude reads my inbox and pulls out what actually needs a reply, so mornings feel a lot lighter.
Bonus: I talk to it with Wispr Flow instead of typing.
Comment CLAUDE and I'll send you how I set it up.
